findings: Changing the idempotency-key format changes the identity of every checkout attempt. A retry after deployment for an attempt previously submitted with the ':' format will use a different key, defeating idempotency across the rollout and potentially permitting a duplicate checkout/charge.
evidence: The only proposed change replaces `${request.orderId}:${request.attemptNumber}` with `${request.orderId}|${request.attemptNumber}`.
gaps: No migration/compatibility handling is shown for keys created before the delimiter change.
No evidence is provided that order IDs and attempt numbers cannot contain the selected delimiter or that the downstream idempotency provider treats this format change safely.
